title: Deep Learning for Screening COVID-19 using Chest X-Ray Images
summary: Approve very narrowly: transfer-learned CNN/DETL classified COVID, pneumonia, normal, and other findings on a small mixed-source CXR dataset with five-fold evaluation; no external clinical utility shown.
ai_technology: Pretrained CNN features support four-class image classification.
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.tested: Five-fold mixed-source dataset evaluation reports 90.13%±0.14 overall accuracy and Grad-CAM clinician-interpretation comparison.
evidence.unknown: Small mixed-source cohort and internal CV only; no external/clinical utility evaluation.
